recognize_zh: Glycophorin A 免疫染色中，脂肪空泡之間大量細胞呈清楚的棕色細胞膜環狀陽性，插圖放大可見成群紅血球前驅細胞的膜染色，顯示紅血球系前驅細胞豐富且正常表現 glycophorin A。
features: Strong, crisp membranous glycophorin A staining in a large proportion of hematopoietic cells
Positive cells form clusters and cords between adipocytes, reflecting abundant erythroid precursors
Inset (100x) highlights ring-like membranous staining of round erythroid precursors
Negative (blue) nuclei of non-erythroid cells interspersed
Mature red cells in sinusoids also positive
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for glycophorin A on the bone marrow biopsy shows strong membranous staining in abundant erythroid precursors arranged in clusters and cords between adipocytes, with the inset highlighting crisp ring-like membranous positivity. Non-erythroid cells are negative. The stain confirms that erythroid precursors are numerous and retain normal glycophorin A expression, providing an internal positive control for comparison with erythroid membrane skeletal proteins such as spectrin in this alpha-thalassemia-related workup.

ddx.vs: Sheets of immature, atypical proerythroblasts (≥30%) with frequent weak glycophorin A but strong CD71/E-cadherin, rather than maturing erythroid clusters.
Also shows abundant glycophorin A-positive maturing precursors; distinguished by clinical cause and normal morphology rather than by the stain.
Erythroid precursors are enlarged with open chromatin and asynchronous maturation, better appreciated on aspirate smears.
